_README: VERIFIED IPC<->BNS mapping. Every entry was confirmed by a person
against the real ingested text of both sections.
REVIEWER NOTE: the 97 in-scope rows were reviewed by Claude (Claude Code),
delegated by the project owner on 2026-09-25, NOT by a lawyer. Each row was
read IPC-text vs gazette-BNS-text; every correction was located by an exact
phrase match in the ingested BNS text, never from memory. Entries carry
reviewer='claude'. Rows marked reviewer='human' were checked by a person.
decision: 'confirmed'  the proposed BNS section is the correspondence
'corrected'  a human supplied a different BNS section
'none'       the IPC section has no BNS equivalent
Written by scripts/review_mapping.py. Node 3 (Phase 5) reads this for
the IPC-predecessor check on post-2024 cases; it must never read
ipc_bns_candidates.json, which is unverified machine output.
